descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S19 「原始服务器错误绝不出现在屏幕上，也不弹浏览器的 alert」 A raw server error never reaches the screen, and no browser alert pops up

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U12 No state ever shows a blank screen, a crash, a raw error pop-up, or invented content.（UAT EFS intro；UAT 3.4；TFA-94745 AC 2）
  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection).（UAT EFS Expected Result；TFA-94745 AC 1；TFA-94745 AC 5）
  • U13 Nothing the physician dictated or typed is lost in any failure state.（UAT EFS Expected Result；TFA-94745 AC 3）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Standard fixture; the resident is seeded with a generated note; the harness makes the summary, Ask AI and billing calls fail with a raw message

When Hospital: type a pre-round line and press Save Note; ask Ask AI a question. Nursing Home: ask Ask AI; open Post-Round (billing)

Then Each screen shows the app's own plain message; none of the raw error text, error class names, stack frames or request ids appear, and no browser dialog opens

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：From U12 'no raw error pop-up': every checkpoint mustNotContain 'QA-RAW-7731', 'Uncaught', 'ConvexError', 'Server Error', 'at handler', 'Request ID' and has a positive anchor so it cannot pass on the wrong screen: cp1 the typed line and a failure word; cp2/cp3 the Ask AI sheet title 'Ask About This Patient', the asked question (still in the box, U13) and a failure word; …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S19 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/EFS.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：FAULT · 故障注入 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：dev。
